hero.caption: This is the most famous of the mobile art works discovered at the Apollo 11 Cave site. The work dates to 30,000 years BP by Carbon 14 dating. This is the oldest figurative art discovered in Africa. This stone shows a theriathropic form consisting of human and animals. The image has been slightly modified for clarity; the original is inset.
